integrity: Exact formulas and finite-dimension optimization established analytically; supplied standalone exact-rational/symbolic checker was executed against the packaged source code. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: The finite-dimensional minimizer is classified by evaluating at most two explicit algebraic candidates; uniform uniqueness in every dimension is not asserted. The volume and ordered-gap/Dirichlet integration method have antecedents in the cited literature. Only the isotropic-constant formula, sharp finite-dimension optimizer reduction and limiting optimal parameter/value are assessed as new. No independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Isotropic optimization of the top-coordinate norm polytopes
